name: omp-bash-classifier
description: Model-judged bash permission requests for OMP: intercepts bash calls the host would auto-approve, classifies them, and prompts on anything risky instead of running it silently.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --module preserve --target esnext --moduleResolution bundler --strict --types bun index.ts eval/run.ts eval/mine-history.ts
